purpose: Plans adversary emulation against the technique map blue maintains; planning only, no tool operation.

phases.goal: map what is publicly known about the target before any contact
phases.blue_signal: look for automated scanning and profile harvesting in edge logs

phases.goal: test whether an exposed service is reachable and exploitable in a lab copy
phases.blue_signal: web exploit signatures, unusual error rates, first-seen user agents

phases.goal: exercise detection of password guessing, dumping and interception
phases.blue_signal: failed-login bursts, LSASS access, unexpected ARP or DNS answers

phases.goal: measure whether injected or side-loaded code is visible to EDR
phases.blue_signal: cross-process memory writes, unsigned DLL side-loads, new USB devices

phases.goal: check whether collection and outbound transfer stand out from baseline
phases.blue_signal: promiscuous interfaces, port sweeps, beacon-shaped TLS, signed-binary trust abuse

rules: every technique must exist in blue/controls.json
scope comes from white/roe.json and is never widened here
a phase with no blue signal is a detection gap to report, not a success
no commands, payloads, offsets or licence patches belong in this file
